source_name: Forbes Ukraine Events — Forbes Banker / Forbes Money
why_relevant: Forbes Banker (2nd edition, 16 April 2026, 300+ participants) assembles bank top managers, the NBU governor and regulators; the event page carries the speaker line-up with current titles, and Forbes Money is the adjacent finance edition. Forbes Ukraine additionally runs employer rankings, tying the same actor map to hiring topics.

source_name: Міжнародний Фінансовий Клуб «БАНКИРЪ» — Digital Banking Hub / Банк року competition
why_relevant: Long-running organiser of the Digital Banking Hub conference series and the All-Ukrainian 'Банк року' competition (XII edition in 2020, continuing). Maintains a dedicated Спікери page per event; observed 2026 speakers included four named NBU officials plus fintech CEOs — regulator-side titles that are otherwise hard to time-stamp.

source_name: Фінансовий клуб (finclub.net) — Financial Club Awards / рейтинг «Банки року»
why_relevant: A second, independent banking award and ranking franchise ('Банки року – 2026') plus its own conference series, with published award presentations listing honoured executives by name and post. Cross-validates FinAwards and covers actors FinAwards misses.

source_name: ГО «Клуб банкірів»
why_relevant: A professional membership body of Ukrainian bankers; membership/board pages and event announcements function as a curated roster of senior banking figures and an entry point to smaller closed-door events not covered by media.

source_name: PSM7 (psm7.com) — payments & fintech trade media, event coverage
why_relevant: The main Ukrainian payments-market trade outlet; announces and reports conferences (e.g. Payments & Security EMA Conference 2026) with agenda and speaker detail, and separately covers appointments. Best single discovery feed for new events in this cell.

source_name: Kyiv International Economic Forum — Speakers directory
why_relevant: KIEF publishes a structured, per-year speakers directory (~169 speakers for the 2026 edition) with photo, organisation and role, and keeps prior years online under /forum/<year>/speakers and /program. The cross-sector scope means it captures bank CEOs alongside government and investor counterparts — ideal for year-over-year title diffing.

source_name: Ukrainian Financial Forum (ICU) — uff.icu
why_relevant: The forum named explicitly in the cell brief: run by investment house ICU since 2014, gathering top financiers, IFI representatives, officials and diplomats. Speaker pages give name + institution + role for the international/investment layer of the actor map. Bilingual (uk and /en/).

source_name: Форум фінансових директорів / CFO.ua — Всі спікери
why_relevant: A standing, cumulative 'all speakers' directory (rather than a per-event page) for the CFO forum community — the single cheapest bulk name→company→title extraction found in this cell, and it covers bank and fintech CFOs/treasurers, a layer under-covered by CEO-focused awards.

source_name: American Chamber of Commerce in Ukraine — events (Ukrainian CFO Forum, Brave CFO Gathering)
why_relevant: Chamber event pages list speakers and moderators with full titles, and its committees (banking & finance) publish member-company representatives — a stable, well-structured English-language mirror of parts of the UA banking actor map, useful when local sites are down.

source_name: Kyiv School of Economics — Освіта / Executive & MBA programmes
why_relevant: Named in the cell brief. KSE runs MBA, Management Mastery and corporate programmes aimed at executives, plus KSE Institute. Faculty/mentor listings and programme-alumni announcements are a slow-moving but reliable index of finance executives, and corporate-programme announcements reveal which banks are investing in leadership pipelines.

source_name: Києво-Могилянська бізнес-школа (kmbs) — програми та Master in Banking and Finance
why_relevant: Named in the cell brief. kmbs runs a Master in Banking and Finance [MBF] for finance practitioners plus owner/top-manager programmes and an active Alumni Club. Cohort and alumni-club material identifies rising bank executives before they hold public titles; programme launches/closures indicate demand shifts in banking talent.

source_name: NBU events section (bank.gov.ua) — Форум молодих дослідників and sector briefings
why_relevant: The regulator's own events and presentations pages name the NBU officials who present each briefing, with their department and title — the authoritative baseline for regulator-side title changes against which conference speaker bios can be validated.

source_name: Power Payment Summit: Ukraine–Europe Bridge (promoney-events)
why_relevant: A newer payments summit positioning UA payment actors toward European counterparts; speaker lists on such bridge events capture Ukrainian executives in their post-relocation or EU-expansion roles, which the domestic events miss.

source_name: 10times — Ukraine finance/banking conference listings
why_relevant: Third-party event aggregator that indexes Ukrainian finance events with dates, venue and sometimes speaker counts; useful purely as a discovery net for events not announced on the association sites. Data quality is uneven and must be confirmed against the organiser.

source_name: Державна служба статистики України (Держстат) — статистика праці / зайнятість за видами економічної діяльності (КВЕД K: Фінансова та страхова діяльність)
why_relevant: Legally mandated statistical authority publishing average headcount of staff (облікова кількість штатних працівників), average wages and labour turnover broken out by KVED section K 'Фінансова та страхова діяльність' — the only official, comparable time series for financial-sector employment and pay in Ukraine.

source_name: Національний банк України — Огляд банківського сектору (Banking Sector Review) та наглядова статистика
why_relevant: NBU supervisory statistics and the quarterly Banking Sector Review carry number of operating structural units (відділення) per bank and headcount indicators for the banking system — the core quantitative feed for branch-network contraction and staffing changes.

source_name: НБУ — регулювання бронювання працівників банків та небанківських фінустанов (mobilisation deferment)
why_relevant: NBU resolutions define the criteria and algorithm by which banks and non-bank financial institutions obtain 'critically important enterprise' status and defer staff from mobilisation — the single most UA-specific driver of bank staffing capacity during wartime.

source_name: Державний центр зайнятості / Державна служба зайнятості — сервіс «Тренди ринку праці»
why_relevant: State Employment Service publishes monthly labour-market indicators (registered unemployed, vacancies by profession and by economic activity), including financial-sector occupations, plus its own analytical bulletins on wartime labour supply.

source_name: Work.ua — аналітика ринку праці та база вакансій (розділ «Фінанси, банк»)
why_relevant: Ukraine's largest job board; its analytics section publishes vacancy/CV volumes and salary medians by category, and the 'Фінанси, банк' vertical is a real-time proxy for bank hiring intensity, role mix and offered pay.

source_name: robota.ua / медіаплатформа budni — аналітика ринку праці та кар'єрні огляди
why_relevant: Second major UA job platform (part of Grupa Pracuj); its budni media arm publishes salary and hiring-trend analyses including finance/banking roles, and robota.ua issues periodic labour-market reports.

source_name: European Business Association (EBA) Ukraine — дослідження ринку праці та огляди зарплат, HR Committee
why_relevant: EBA runs a standing HR Committee and publishes recurring labour-market/salary research across member companies (which include most foreign-owned banks in Ukraine), with headline findings on wage growth and talent shortage published free.

source_name: KSE Institute (Київська школа економіки) — Human Capital Chartbook та дослідження ринку праці
why_relevant: KSE Institute produces the most rigorous wartime human-capital research in Ukraine (skills deficits, migration/return, employer hiring difficulty), providing the macro backdrop against which bank-specific staffing shortages must be read.

source_name: Міністерство економіки України — Стратегія зайнятості населення до 2030 року та політика ринку праці
why_relevant: Policy owner for employment strategy; its strategy documents and consultations set out state assumptions on workforce supply, reskilling and returning migrants that constrain financial-sector hiring.

source_name: Opendatabot — аналітика вакансій, зарплат та реєстраційних даних компаній
why_relevant: Aggregates open state registers plus job-board data into regularly published labour-market analytics (average pay, vacancy vs CV dynamics) and offers an API; also a fast route to registry-level corporate/officer changes for banks and their subsidiaries.

source_name: Brain Source International — executive search та аналітика ринку праці (фінанси/банки)
why_relevant: Long-established UA executive-search firm explicitly covering banking and financial services; sells labour-market analysis and publishes market commentary — a practitioner view of senior banking talent scarcity and comp levels.

source_name: ANCOR (Анкор Персонал Україна) — огляди заробітних плат, пільг і компенсацій
why_relevant: Staffing group with a Ukrainian entity that sells salary/benefits benchmarking surveys and (historically) ran Randstad Employer Brand Research in Ukraine — a paid but methodologically structured comp benchmark relevant to bank back-office and retail roles.

source_name: FINBALANCE — фінансово-регуляторне видання
why_relevant: Covers NBU regulatory detail closely, including the criteria and algorithm for deferring (бронювання) bank and non-bank staff from mobilisation — hard to find summarised elsewhere.
